row.evidence: CosmoLex's pricing page lists security as SOC 2 controls, encryption and two-factor authentication with no SSO or SCIM, and its knowledge base documents only manual user management (admins add, edit and delete users in User Management).
row.notes: Plans: Launch $49, Core $99, Pro $129 per user/month billed yearly (monthly billing costs $120 more per user per year). No SAML/OIDC SSO or SCIM found on the pricing page, site sitemap or the 3,015-URL knowledge-base sitemap; sign-in security is username/password with 2FA (SMS or Microsoft Authenticator). Users are added, edited and deleted manually; adding a user incurs an immediate prorated charge. An Open API (ProfitSolv Developer Portal, OAuth, scoped Read/Write/Delete per data area) is available on the Pro plan, but its reference is behind a portal login and it is not documented as covering user management, so user_api fields stay null. No Okta OIN or Entra gallery app found.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Open API (general data API) is a Pro-plan feature; whether it covers users is not public.

scim.notes: No SCIM documentation found anywhere on cosmolex.com or kb.cosmolex.com.

limitations.text: Open API is a Pro-plan feature; its endpoint guide and schemas sit inside the ProfitSolv Developer Portal after sign-in, so whether user records are exposed is not public.

fallbacks.notes: Users are added (invite or admin-set password), edited and deleted manually in Account Management > User Management; deleting a user blocks login and keeps historical entries.
